responsibility: This machine description implements the MIPS paired-single floating-point and MIPS-3D extensions. It defines UNSPEC codes and instruction patterns for paired-single conditional moves, lane permutations, specialized floating-point comparisons and branches over paired condition codes, reciprocal and reciprocal-square-root refinement instructions, and vector-style reductions over V2SF, providing the backend support for -mpaired-single and -mmips3d code generation.
